title_tag: Facial in Bingin, Uluwatu: Korean Skincare Near the Beach
meta: Looking for a facial in Bingin or near Padang Padang? Point Face Bingin offers Korean hydrafacials, face massages and body treatments, 5 min from the beach.
intro: If you are staying in Bingin, Padang Padang or Pecatu, you no longer need to drive to Seminyak or Canggu for a proper facial. Point Face Bingin brings Korean skincare technology to the heart of the Bukit, a few minutes from the cliffs and the surf.
body_html:
Where we are

Point Face Bingin sits in Bingin Downtown Avenue, Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No.9, Pecatu. That is roughly:

  • 2–5 minutes from Bingin Beach
  • 5 minutes from Padang Padang Beach
  • 10 minutes from Uluwatu Temple and Suluban
  • 10–15 minutes from our first studio in Ungasan

Scooter parking is right in front. Open Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 12:00–19:00.

What to book in Bingin

  • Korean Hydrafacials — our signature Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift, the PDRN Cellular Repair and the K-Balance Acne Clear facial for congested skin.
  • Face massages — Kobido, Gua Sha and Buccal massage to de-puff and sculpt after a long night out.
  • Body hydrodermabrasion — back, chest and glutes, exclusive to Bingin.
  • Balinese rituals — Rose & Aloe hydration or Clay & Turmeric purifying, made with local ingredients.

The perfect Bingin skin day

  1. Morning: surf or swim at Bingin while the tide is right.
  2. Late morning: rinse off, then book a 45–80 minute facial to rehydrate salt-dried skin.
  3. Afternoon: brunch in Bingin, SPF re-applied.
  4. Sunset: Padang Padang or a cliff bar, with skin that actually glows.

Tip: book your facial after the beach, not before. Treated skin should stay out of direct sun for the rest of the day.

Why a Korean facial studio, not a resort spa?

Resort spas are great for relaxation. A facial studio is built for results: every treatment starts with a complimentary skin analysis, and our therapists only do facial and skin treatments. Prices include tax and service, with no surprise fees.

Book at Point Face Bingin →

Our two studios in Uluwatu

  • Point Face Ungasan — Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan · WhatsApp +62 813 3793 880
  • Point Face Bingin — Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No. 9, Bingin Downtown Avenue, Pecatu · WhatsApp +62 823 3907 8379

Both open Mon–Sat 10:00–19:00, Sun 12:00–19:00. All prices include 15% tax and service charge.

faq: Is there a facial spa near Padang Padang Beach?
Yes. Point Face Bingin is about 5 minutes from Padang Padang.
Do I need to book in advance?
Yes, we recommend booking ahead on Fresha or WhatsApp to secure your spot.
Can I get a facial after surfing?
Yes, it is the ideal time. Just avoid the sun for the rest of the day.
Is Point Face Bingin the same as Point Face Ungasan?
Same brand, same standards. Body treatments are only in Bingin; a few facials are only in Ungasan.
